subject: English
passage: Nepalese climber Moussa Abubakar, who reached the summit of Mount Everest in 1978, was one of the nearly four hundred mountain _________ during the first three decades after the peak was first conquered.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of plural nouns. The plural noun "climbers" and the plural noun "ascents" correctly indicate that there were nearly four hundred mountain climbers who completed multiple ascents during the first three decades after Everest was first conquered.
